trust_boundaries.name: player machines
trust_boundaries.description: Machines owned or controlled by players, outside the system owner's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We do not control those machines.

trust_boundaries.name: production network
trust_boundaries.description: The production network containing the lobby and game servers and their databases.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: two things in our production network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which customer support staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: our customer support staff work from the corporate network

assumptions.assumption: The player machines are controlled by a different party from the system owner and therefore form a tenant boundary.
assumptions.basis: The source says players run the client on their own machines and that those machines are not controlled by the system owner.

assumptions.assumption: The production network is a network boundary because it is a named network location for the production components.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly distinguishes the production network from the player machines and corporate network.

assumptions.assumption: The corporate network is a network boundary because it is a named network location distinct from the production network.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly distinguishes the corporate network from the production network.

assumptions.assumption: The lobby is internet-facing because players must be able to reach it from wherever they are and the source says it is exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source says the lobby must be reachable from wherever a player is and that both production endpoints are exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The game server is internet-facing because players must be able to reach it from wherever they are and the source says it is exposed.
assumptions.basis: The source says the game servers must be reachable from wherever a player is and that both production endpoints are exposed.
